page.overview:
What is Pirate Hideout?

Pirate Hideout is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions to the southwest of Capo and the northwest of Rusalka. It's populated by pirates.

The Warriors of Light depart Capo to the Pirate Hideout to meet the pirates' boss, Bikke, and ask him to free Port Capo. Bikke calls himself King of Pirates and orders the pirates to capture the warriors, but they are unsuccessful.

Bikke joins in the battle, but is defeated. The warriors again ask Bikke to free the port but he claims that it had been the imperials' with idea to capture the warriors and bring them to Rusalka. He advises the warriors to avoid Rusalka and attempts to bring them back to Capo. On the ship, Aigis orders Bikke to change course and head to Rusalka as the enemy would never expect the warriors to go there on purpose.

The pot at the Entrance of the cave will restore HP/MP fully.
